hypotheses.intervention: Before-fix tests contain behavioral constraints missed during browsing. Retrieving a matching assertion before editing improves real issue resolution.
hypotheses.competing: The local tests do not reveal the required behavior, or the agent cannot translate it into a correct edit. Retrieval adds calls with no net rescue.

pairing: All 31 locked cases, identical model, sampling, budgets and inputs. Alternate the leading arm by locked case index.
exposure: The GPU worker sees only frozen before-fix source, issue text and dependencies. Official optional graph caches and hints are absent for both arms. An independent CPU worker grades both patches with the frozen tests.
advance: All 31 complete native pairs, positive lower bound of paired 95% bootstrap CI, real positive retrieval in at least one rescued case, and legal run-time and submission artifacts. Record regressions, tool calls, errors and elapsed time before an official entry.
